backends.note: First Claude account. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR selects which stored login the claude CLI resolves.
Second Claude account. This is also the account the interactive router session runs on; the pool only ever influences NEW spawns and never logs out or kills an interactive session.
Per-invocation API key, so two Cursor accounts run concurrently without any logout/login cycling. key_file defaults to ~/.config/firstmate/keys/<id>.key and may be omitted.
key_file omitted, so it defaults to ~/.config/firstmate/keys/cursor-2.key. A missing or empty key file disables this backend with a stated reason instead of failing a spawn.
